surah.personality_title: Al-Fajr — The Breaking Dawn & The Tranquil Soul's Return
surah.personality_summary: Historical, dramatic, socioeconomic, spiritually climactic. Oaths by dawn and ten nights recall the ruin of ancient monolithic civilizations ('Ad, Thamud, Pharaoh), exposes the shallow theology of measuring divine love by wealth, and culminates in the most celebrated spiritual welcome in scripture: 'O reassured soul, return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing to Him.'
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Fajr (The Dawn) is the 89th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 30 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.translation_saheeh: By the dawn
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the Daybreak

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] ten nights
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the Ten Nights

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the even and the odd

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the night when it passes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the passing night––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمࣱ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِذِي حِجْرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هل في ذلك قسم لذي حجر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: is this oath strong enough for a rational person

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الم تر كيف فعل ربك بعاد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Have you [Prophet] considered how your Lord dealt with [the people] of 'Ad

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: of Iram, [the city] of lofty pillars

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: الَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: التي لم يخلق مثلها في البلاد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The likes of whom had never been created in the land
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: whose like has never been made in any land

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the Thamud, who hewed into the rocks in the valley

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the mighty and powerful Pharaoh

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: All of them committed excesses in their lands

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And increased therein the corruption
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and spread corruption there

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord let a scourge of punishment loose on them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, your Lord is in observation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Your Lord is always watchful

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَمَّا الْإِنْسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاما الانسان اذا ما ابتلاه ربه فاكرمه ونعمه فيقول ربي اكرمن
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [The nature of] man is that, when his Lord tries him through honour and blessings, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واما اذا ما ابتلاه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربي اهانن
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but when He tries him through the restriction of his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! But you do not honor the orphan
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! You [people] do not honour orphans

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you do not urge one another to feed the poor

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلࣰ ا لَّمࣰّ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you consume inheritance greedily

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبࣰّ ا جَمࣰّ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you love wealth with immense love
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and you love wealth with a passion

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكࣰّ ا دَكࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَلَّا إِذَا دُكَّتِ الْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلا اذا دكت الارض دكا دكا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! When the earth is pounded to dust, pounded and pounded

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفࣰّ ا صَفࣰّ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when your Lord comes with the angels, rank upon rank

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنْسَانُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وجيء يومئذ بجهنم ۚ يومئذ يتذكر الانسان وانى له الذكرى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when Hell is that Day brought near- on that Day man will take heed, but what good will that be to him then

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He will say, ‘Would that I had provided for this life to come!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day, no one will punish as He punishes

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and no one will bind as He binds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘[But] you, soul at peace

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: return to your Lord well pleased and well pleasing

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And enter among My [righteous] servants
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: go in among My servants

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And enter My Paradise
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and into My Garden.’
